async def run(items):
    keys = {
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await key(item): item for item in items
    }
    selected = [item for item in items if
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await keep(item)]
    values = {item for item in items if
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await keep(item)}
    indexed = {item: item for item in items if

        await keep(item)}
